messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 — ILB 502/504 spike affecting Private VPC cross-region egress (eu->us). Alerting on-call. Link: https://go.metrics/redwood/ilb-crossregion

pagerduty: Paging samir (oncall) for SEV2: ILB cross-region errors for Private VPC customers — acknowledge in channel when on it :phone:

samir: acked, on it. grabbing metrics and logs now.

samir: quick summary from Grafana — 502s up 18x from baseline around 1729456000, error signature shows repeated `authz_grpc_timeout` coming from auth-proxy layer in front of ILBs. Trend correlates with peak in auth-provider 5xxs (third-party).

samir: running quick checks — gcloud health-checks look green but backend logs show: `upstream response: 504, context: authz-grpc deadline exceeded`

```# tail from auth-proxy (privatevpc-eu-backend)
2024-11-20T22:02:01Z WARN auth-proxy timeout id=0xfeed authz_grpc_timeout provider=acme-idp region=eu
2024-11-20T22:02:05Z ERROR upstream 504 request_id=abc123 path=/v1/token
```

samir: observability vendor (ingest) also showing elevated 503 from their public ingest endpoint at the same window — looks like two dependencies degrading in tandem.

raj: joining — seeing route fanout from eu->us via ILB proxying. If auth provider is slow, control plane retries amplify traffic across regions. Could be a dependency storm causing cross-region tail latency.

samir: confirmed: cross-region fanout multiplier increased; Private VPC ILB config has fallback to remote region when local backends report unhealthy — that behavior is amplifying auth-related failures.

samir: mitigation options I'm considering: (1) throttle control-plane retries for Private VPC (2) change route preference to regional ILB (prefer eu only) for affected customers (3) temporary global fallback disable for Private VPC to prevent cross-region amplification.

jess: I'd prefer (2) + (3) initially — reduce blast radius quickly. We can enable regional-fallback only for a small cohort, validate, then roll.

maria: preparing customer comms. Draft: "We're seeing elevated request failures for customers using Private VPC cross-region routing between EU and US. We're applying a regional routing fallback to reduce errors and will update when upstream auth provider recovers." Want me to post to affected customers list?

samir: go ahead, ping CS after we apply change. I'll apply a regional-fallback policy for the affected project tags now. Command: ```redwoodctl routing update --scope privatevpc --selector 'tag:eu-cross' --policy regional-prefer --dry-run=false --reason "mitigate auth provider timeouts causing cross-region amplification"```

opsbot: Action started: routing.update id=rt-20241120-01 target=privatevpc selector=tag:eu-cross policy=regional-prefer

opsbot: Action completed: routing.update id=rt-20241120-01 status=success changed=12 services

samir: change applied. monitoring heatmap — 502 rate for cohort dropped ~70% in 60s. latency slightly increased for some requests but overall error budget improving.

incident-bot: Runbook step: enabled regional-prefer policy for selector tag:eu-cross. Next: monitor for rollback conditions (error rate > 20% above baseline for 10m) or auth-provider recovery message.

jess: I'm taking the handoff from samir for ongoing mitigation and follow-ups with GCP + auth provider. Samir — can you add links to the logs and any correlation artifacts?

samir: added: https://logs.internal/redwood/trace/abc123 and a short perf snapshot in the incident doc. Also opened ticket with auth provider (ACME-IDP) — ticket 54321 OPENS: "high timeout rate from Redwood customers during 22:00 UTC window". CC'd GCP support for ILB behavior question.

maria: customer message posted to status page and emailed affected accounts. Content: "We have applied a regional routing change for affected Private VPCs to mitigate request failures while a third-party auth provider and an observability ingest endpoint recover. Some requests may see slightly higher latency; functional availability has improved."

support-bot: Notifying: #customer-impact (5 customers), #account-managers (3 people). Template used: private-vpc-crossregion-fallback-20241120.

jess: next steps: keep regional-prefer in place for 2 hours, monitor, coordinate timeline with ACME-IDP and vendor. If auth provider recovers, we'll gradually re-enable cross-region fallback via canary rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%). If ILB fanout returns we'll escalate to GCP SRE.

raj: I'll also temporarily reduce control-plane retry multiplier for Private VPC by 50% to limit amplification. Command: ```redwoodctl infra set --param controlplane.retry_multiplier --scope privatevpc --value 0.5 --reason "limit amplification during third-party timeouts"```

opsbot: Action started: infra.set id=infra-20241120-22-01
opsbot: Action completed: infra.set id=infra-20241120-22-01 status=success

samir: hands off complete — jess, you're now oncall owner for this incident. Samir out. :wave:

jess: ack. I will keep updates here. Reached out to GCP (case GCP-87654) to confirm ILB health propagation behavior across regions and whether we can speed up fail-open for local backends. Also waiting on ACME-IDP ticket 54321 for root cause.

jess: monitoring update 22:30 UTC — regional-prefer cohort error rate stable and within target. Observability ingest vendor reported partial recovery at 22:27 UTC; their dashboard shows decreasing 5xx rate. ACME-IDP still showing intermittent timeouts (we have timeline from their ticket).

maria: follow-up customer note drafted for tomorrow morning summarizing root cause (third-party auth provider & vendor ingest degradation) and mitigations. Asking for CS to prep for any escalations.

jess: leaving this thread open; status: mitigation in progress, severity remains SEV2 because multiple customers impacted but functionality degraded, not fully down. Will update when auth provider confirms resolution or we revert routing policy.

incident-bot: Incident updated: mitigation_in_progress, severity=2, owner=jess, incident_channel=#incidents-1729456123. If degradation reoccurs, page oncall.

jess: closing shift note — handoff to morning oncall: please verify auth-provider ticket and vendor ingest health before reverting regional routing. Logging all commands and timestamps in the incident doc. ""
